page_objective: Define SIPANEL website performance standards, Core Web Vitals targets, engineering-asset optimization rules, technical diagram loading systems, multilingual delivery strategy, and production-grade frontend performance requirements for industrial envelope digital experiences.

performance_philosophy.statement: Performance is part of SIPANEL's engineering credibility. Every interface must feel fast, stable, controlled, and technically reliable across mobile, desktop, multilingual, and industrial field-use environments.

performance_qa_checklist: Hero image is optimized and preloaded.
No heavy PDFs are embedded on mobile.
ACP and façade visuals are optimized.
Standing seam technical diagrams load progressively.
forbidden_patterns: Loading all high-resolution diagrams on page load
Layout shifts caused by late-loading assets
Full-resolution façade galleries on initial load
implementation_notes: Performance must be planned during design and development, not fixed only after launch.
Technical visuals are critical trust assets but must be delivered progressively.
Mobile speed directly affects trust, SEO, consultant engagement, and RFQ conversion.
Performance standards must support sandwich panels, ACP façades, standing seam roofing, ZIP systems, and industrial envelope engineering equally.
Performance governance should be reviewed before every major production release.
